caption: The drawing features a single ceramic jug depicted in the center of the page. The jug is outlined in black and has a rounded body that tapers slightly at the base, a narrow neck with horizontal bands near the top, and a single handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder. Near the top of the jug, there is a blue brushstroke design that curves upward. The background consists of a plain, uniformly light beige or off-white surface without any additional objects, shading, or details.
title: Jug
